headline: Borosil Renewables Q2 profit jumps 53% to ₹70 crore
summary: Borosil Renewables reported a 53% increase in net profit to ₹70 crore for the second quarter. However, EBITDA declined by 15% as the company faced higher fuel surcharges and costs associated with routine furnace maintenance. Management expects a recovery in earnings starting from the third quarter of FY27 as production volumes and selling prices stabilize. The results reflect a mixed performance amid operational headwinds.
why_it_matters: Operational costs may weigh on near-term stock performance.
